verdict.rationale: Swell documents environment-specific secret keys: sk_test_ keys route requests to the store's test environment, while sk_live_ keys target live data, so testing stays separate from production. The CLI can also push configuration to a development store. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how isolated the test environment is (separate data, reset or seeding behavior), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Keys are environment-specific: secret keys prefixed sk_test_ route requests to your store's test environment, while sk_live_ keys target live data.
swell app push: push configuration files to a development store
